reason: Policy strictly states that a flight can only be cancelled if booked within the last 24 hours, cancelled by the airline, in business cabin, or covered by insurance for a covered reason. Reservation RE0FAN was created on 2024-05-01 (over 24 hours ago), has economy cabin, has insurance 'no', and flights are available (not cancelled). The agent violates policy by cancelling an ineligible reservation.
